senses.gloss: harnessing, taking possession of a working animal by an act resembling harnessing.
units: Tosef. ib. I, 8 איזו היא מ׳ מסר לו … ומוֹסִירָהּ (ed. Zuck. ומוסֵירה, Var. במוסרה) what is m’sirah? He (the seller) hands him (the buyer) a bit and he harnesses it (the animal); Kidd. 22ᵇ כיצד במ׳ אחזה וכ׳ what is bimsirah (Kidd. I, 4)? He seizes its hoof, hair &c., a. fr.
<cite ref="Gittin 9b:14">Gitt. 9ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>עדי מ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="K01281"><he>כְּרַת</he></cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4:2">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 31:5">Num. XXXI, 5</cite>) <he>שנים … במ׳</he> twelve thousand men were raised by levy, opp. <he>בנדבה</he> as volunteers.
